limitations: ROI is manually registered; parking lines are not automatically detected.
Reference differences and sticker proposals are candidates, not verified vehicle segmentation or ground truth.

RealSense enumeration showed a named-mutex error during preview; physical device acceptance remains pending.

Historical tests and reports are retained separately and are not counted as V19 passes.
